item.title: First Baby of 2026 Born in Schuylkill County
item.description: Schuylkill County welcomed its first new arrival of 2026 on New Year’s Day at Lehigh Valley Hospital—Schuylkill. Skye and Jesse Fotusky of Tamaqua proudly welcomed their daughter, Wren Ann Fotusky, who was born at 8:34 a.m. on January 1, 2026. Baby Wren weighed 6 pounds, 6 ounces and measured 20 inches long at birth. LVHN/Jefferson Health confirmed Wren as the first baby born in Schuylkill County in 2026.
